newsitem.title: RUSSIA: NizhnevartovskNG oil output up in H1.
newsitem.headline: NizhnevartovskNG oil output up in H1.

text.p: AO Nizhnevartovskneftegaz oil production in the first half of this year was 360,000 tonnes higher than a year earlier, an official at major shareholder Tyumenskaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya said on Thursday.
But Nizhnevartovskneftegaz's cumulative debt grew by 1.5 trillion roubles to seven trillion roubles, he told Reuters.
He said fines for overdue payments dating back to 1993 were the main reason for the rising losses, while over-spending on capital investment in needed oilfield infrastructure also pushed up losses.
He was unable to provide absolute figures for Nizhnevartovskneftegaz's oil output.
